description: Check 1 to 25 XRPL domains for registration status and cost. Use for questions like "is <name>.xrp taken?", "how much does <name>.xrp cost?", "who owns <name>.xrp?", or to verify availability before registering. Accepts .xrp, .xrpl, .xrpfi, .rlusd TLDs (defaults to .xrp when omitted). Returns availability, price in XRP and RLUSD, owner address, profile metadata if registered, and a web URL for the user to register if available. Also returns invalid_domains for inputs that fail validation.

domains.description: List of domains to check. Each may include or omit the TLD; defaults to .xrp.

name: check_domains
